name: thread-affinity
description: A genuinely non-Send and non-Sync Rust owner remains in a thread-local arena behind a checked scoped handle.

cases.reason: Scoped PureScript access and replay of the effect acquire independent thread-local owners.
Existential retention of a handle is permitted; it is not a retained owner. Main checks its expired native backstop.
A concrete fresh region cannot escape directly.
A deferred action retains its fresh region.
Capturing the handle in a closure does not erase the Local region.
An existential old region cannot be instantiated as the new live region.
A Local operation is not an ordinary schedulable Effect.
Clients cannot unwrap a Local action to bypass the scoped runner.
Native unchecked access bridge is private to the adapter.
Explicit unsafeCoerce is outside the static guarantee. Compile-only; never executed.
